_comment: Trigger boundary set for description tuning. should_trigger=true must invoke skill-review; false must defer to the named skill. Use with skill-creator's description optimizer; the false cases are the load-bearing negatives that keep this skill from stealing code-review / security-review / verify / skill-creator triggers.
